cards.ex: We've been friends through thick and thin.
cards.exUz: Biz qiyin va oson kunlarda do'st bo'lib keldik.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vaziyatda, yaxshi ham yomon ham paytlarda do'st bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: She's always been a shoulder to cry on for me.
cards.exUz: U har doim men uchun dardkash do'st bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Dardini aytishga tayyor bo'lgan, yordam beradigan do'st.

cards.ex: Don't worry, I've got your back.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olma, men seni himoya qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash, yordam berish va himoya qilish.

cards.ex: I'll always be there for you.
cards.exUz: Men har doim sening yoningda bo'laman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga yordam berishga tayyor bo'lish, ularni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: He turned out to be a fair-weather friend.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida xushomadgo'y do'st ekanligi ma'lum bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan, qiyin paytlarda qochadigan odam.

cards.ex: They decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Ular yarashishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi kelishmovchiliklarni unutib, yarashish.

cards.ex: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
cards.exUz: Qiyin paytda yordam bergan do'st qadrdon do'stdir.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytda yordam beradigan haqiqiy do'st.

cards.ex: Their bond of friendship is very strong.
cards.exUz: Ularning do'stlik rishtalari juda mustahkam.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar orasidagi kuchli aloqa, bog'liqlik.

cards.ex: They swore loyalty to each other.
cards.exUz: Ular bir-birlariga sodiq bo'lishga qasamyod qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga sodiq bo'lishga va'da berish.

cards.ex: We'll support you through thick and thin.
cards.exUz: Biz seni qiyin va oson kunlarda qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vaziyatda, yaxshi ham yomon ham paytlarda birga bo'lish.

cards.ex: He always sticks up for his friends.
cards.exUz: U har doim do'stlarini himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir himoya qilish, ularni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: I confide in her with all my secrets.
cards.exUz: Men unga barcha sirlarimni ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga o'z sirlaringni ishonib aytish.

cards.ex: I get along with my colleagues really well.
cards.exUz: Men hamkasblarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish, birga yaxshi vaqt o'tkazish.

cards.ex: We used to be close, but we drifted apart.
cards.exUz: Biz yaqin edik, lekin vaqt o'tishi bilan uzoqlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan do'stlik aloqalarini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: They managed to patch things up after their argument.
cards.exUz: Ular janjaldan keyin munosabatlarini tiklashga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Janjaldan keyin munosabatlarni tiklash.

cards.ex: My dog is my true companion.
cards.exUz: Mening itim sodiq o'rtog'imdir.
cards.uzDef: Sizga har doim sodiq bo'ladigan, siz bilan birga bo'ladigan do'st.

cards.ex: Birds of a feather flock together.
cards.exUz: O'xshash odamlar birga bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xarakterlari, qiziqishlari o'xshash odamlar.

cards.ex: They are a close-knit family.
cards.exUz: Ular ahil oiladir.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda yaqin, mustahkam aloqaga ega bo'lgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: He's loyal to a fault.
cards.exUz: U me'yoridan ortiq sodiq.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari sodiq, ba'zan zarariga ham sodiq bo'lish.

cards.ex: Blood is thicker than water, so I support my family.
cards.exUz: Qon qarindoshligi muhimroq, shuning uchun oilamni qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari bilan aloqa boshqa munosabatlardan muhimroq.

cards.ex: She's a shoulder to lean on when things get tough.
cards.exUz: U qiyin paytlarda suyanadigan tayanchdir.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga qiyin paytda yordam beradigan, suyanadigan odam.

cards.ex: Their friendship is based on mutual respect.
cards.exUz: Ularning do'stligi o'zaro hurmatga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini hurmat qilish, fikrlarini qadrlash.

cards.ex: They share an unbreakable bond.
cards.exUz: Ularning buzilmas rishtasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Ajratib bo'lmaydigan, juda kuchli aloqa.

cards.ex: He's a trustworthy friend.
cards.exUz: U ishonchli do'st.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchga loyiq bo'lgan, sirlarni saqlay oladigan.

cards.ex: It's hard for me to open up to people.
cards.exUz: Menga odamlarga dilimni ochish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga o'z his-tuyg'ularingizni, sirlaringizni aytish.

cards.ex: I'll always stand by you.
cards.exUz: Men har doim seni qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda ham kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: She always puts her friends first.
cards.exUz: U har doim do'stlarini birinchi o'ringa qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir manfaatlarini o'zingiznikidan ustun qo'yish.

cards.ex: I feel like she's a kindred spirit.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u mening qarindosh ruhim.
cards.uzDef: Qalbi, fikrlari sizga yaqin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: He's been a rock for me during this difficult time.
cards.exUz: U bu qiyin paytlarda menga tayanch bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda sizga yordam beradigan, ishonchli odam.

cards.ex: She's been my lifelong friend.
cards.exUz: U mening umrbod do'stim.
cards.uzDef: Umr bo'yi do'st bo'lib qoladigan odam.
